title: Plug and Play with Prompts: A Prompt Tuning Approach for Controlling Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to steer text generation away from harmful, abusive, and toxic outputs by using a discriminator trained on the Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification dataset. The evaluation measures target style accuracy (non-toxic generation), fluency (perplexity), diversity (Dist-n), and includes qualitative comparisons of detoxified outputs.
